explication: Observer Patch Holography is a research program that reconstructs physical structures from bounded observers, their records, and consensus. The README describes a conceptual route from observer consistency through spacetime, fields, quantum structure and matter to constants and empirical tests; the tree contains separate research lanes rather than one demonstrated runtime pipeline. The graph preserves these major branches. Some subsystem paths are exact directories because their implementation was not sampled, so uncertain implementation-level links are omitted.
